title: paeonia officinalis subsp. humilis
intro: Paeonia officinalis subsp. humilis, commonly known as dwarf peony, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Paeonia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and anxiety, due to its health benefits in reducing stress and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia officinalis subsp. humilis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents in Paeonia officinalis subsp. humilis, including paeoniflorin, paeonol, and paeonilactone-B, have been found to have significant pharmacological properties that contribute to its medicinal value.
